data.name: Eschew Materials (Mythic)
data.description: You can cast even the most powerful spells without using material components.

raw_tokens.value: You can cast even the most powerful spells without using material components.

You can cast any spell with a material component costing %1 gp or less without providing that component. If you expend one use of mythic power while casting a spell that requires a material component costing %2 gp or less, you can cast it without providing that component. Expending two uses of mythic power instead allows you to cast a spell that requires a material component costing %3 gp or less without providing that component.|10*MythicLevel|50*MythicLevel|100*MythicLevel
